name: rvrs
description: Network diagnostics for agents with the rvrs CLI: ping, traceroute, MTR, dig for DNS, and BGP lookups with ASN and RPKI. Every run is a JSON report, compared with the history rvrs keeps, so an agent can say what changed and name the runs that show it. The rvrs MCP server adds the person's account: runs from every device and node, drawn in the chat.

interface.shortDescription: Traceroute, MTR, ping, DNS and BGP runs from your rvrs account
interface.longDescription: Reads your rvrs account: the runs your iPhone, your CLIs and your nodes made, compared with each other and drawn as rvrs draws them, with a link to every run. With a shell, the skill makes new runs with the rvrs CLI.
